explainBack.question: Why doesn't installing the Gemini Windows app mean Gemini can automatically read my screen, files or email?
explainBack.answer: Because the app only changes how you reach Gemini — Alt + Space opens a window beside your work — while access to your content still requires your explicit choices: you must paste text in, upload an image, or deliberately connect Google apps like Gmail and Drive. The account you sign in with, and on managed accounts an administrator, still governs what is available.
explainBack.expectedEvidence: P006 (uploads and connections are chosen), P008 (explicitly denies automatic screen/file access), P005 and P009 (account and admin controls persist).
explainBack.assessment: The article fully supports this causal answer in ordinary language; the route-versus-permissions distinction is stated, not merely implied.

unseenTransfer.scenario: A colleague installs a new desktop version of a different AI assistant her firm uses in the browser. Seeing it float over her open client spreadsheet, she assumes it is already reading the spreadsheet and asks it to 'summarise this file' without attaching anything, then worries it has been ingesting client data all along.
unseenTransfer.question: Using the article's mechanism, what should she conclude and check before trusting or fearing the desktop app?
unseenTransfer.answer: A desktop app is a new door into the same service, not a new grant of access: sitting beside a document is not reading it. She should check which account she is signed into (personal versus firm-managed, where an administrator controls availability), look at what connections or uploads the app actually requests, and deliberately provide only content she is comfortable sharing — pasting or attaching the spreadsheet is her choice, not automatic.
unseenTransfer.expectedEvidence: The route-versus-function model (P004), the opt-in connection rule (P006), the no-automatic-access limit (P008) and the persistence of account/admin controls (P005, P009).
unseenTransfer.assessment: The article's mechanism resolves this genuinely new situation cleanly; a reader who absorbed P004–P009 can both dispel the false fear and take the right precaution.
